package catalog

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func isValidCatalogStatus(status int) bool {
	return status == domain.CatalogStatusNoActive || status == domain.CatalogStatusActive
}

func normalizeCatalogID(value string) (string, error) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(value); err != nil {
		return "", domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return value, nil
}

func normalizeTrackTranslations(entries []domain.TrackI18n) ([]domain.TrackI18n, error) {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{})
	result := make([]domain.TrackI18n, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.I18nID <= 0 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		entry.Title = strings.TrimSpace(entry.Title)
		entry.Description = strings.TrimSpace(entry.Description)
		if entry.Title == "" || entry.Description == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, ok := seen[entry.I18nID]; ok {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[entry.I18nID] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result, nil
}

	seen := make(map[int]struct{})

}

func normalizeGroupTranslations(entries []domain.CourseGroupI18n) ([]domain.CourseGroupI18n, error) {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{})
	result := make([]domain.CourseGroupI18n, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.I18nID <= 0 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		entry.Title = strings.TrimSpace(entry.Title)
		entry.Description = strings.TrimSpace(entry.Description)
		if entry.Title == "" || entry.Description == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, ok := seen[entry.I18nID]; ok {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[entry.I18nID] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validateCatalogTranslationLanguages(ctx context.Context, i18n repository.I18nRepository, ids []int, requireRUEN bool) error {
	if i18n == nil {
		if requireRUEN && len(ids) < 2 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return nil
	}
	languages := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		entry, err := i18n.GetByID(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		languages[strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(entry.Language))] = struct{}{}
	}
	if requireRUEN {
		if _, ok := languages["ru"]; !ok {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, ok := languages["en"]; !ok {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func uniqueCatalogTranslationIDs(groups ...[]int) []int {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{})
	result := make([]int, 0)
	for _, ids := range groups {
		for _, id := range ids {
			if _, ok := seen[id]; ok {
				continue
			}
			seen[id] = struct{}{}
			result = append(result, id)
		}
	}
	return result
}
